environment.description: Same CLI binary distributed internally. LaunchDarkly project 'oauth-cli-prod' has the flag 'oauth-cli-strict-redirect-validation' configured with a targeting rule: default variation is TRUE (index 0) for all contexts matching kind='service'. The flag's off-variation is also set to variation index 0 (TRUE), meaning even if targeting is toggled off, the SDK returns TRUE. The fallback value in code is FALSE but the LD relay proxy (running as sidecar on each developer machine via corporate MDM-enforced daemon at localhost:8030) ensures the SDK always connects and retrieves the server-side TRUE value. Additionally, the LD project has a prerequisite flag 'kill-legacy-oauth-paths' that must evaluate TRUE before 'oauth-cli-strict-redirect-validation' can be evaluated, and 'kill-legacy-oauth-paths' is permanently enabled with no off state configured.

config.mdm_policy: Corporate MDM ensures relay proxy daemon runs continuously
